details:
Although the agenda for inventory has risen, here are some ideas for realistic specifications.
Public Private
Can be installed as a pedestal in the world, can be cloned, FAV can be public,You should be able to set whether it is private or not.This is set separately from what can be grabbed.

Object type
Toggles whether the object follows gravity, is not, is grabable, or is not. You also need to consider the layer of collider interference for the player and the world.This should be temporarily switchable with an animation override in the accessory.(Grabbing is possible for installation, switching to attributes that follow gravity → floating attributes, moving, and grabbing are impossible after installation)
This can easily be done using the world settings.Multiple items that can be grabbed in one item, items that can only be grabbed by the installer, or vice versa,We must consider the possibility of expressions such as

Performance Rank
In addition to inventory, performance rank will be set individually for each item,Items with fancy effects, such as a large number of particles or lights, that will be devoted to processing will be blocked by Saftey.
Like the avatar, the number of polygons, the number of bones, and the special gimmick (movement related) used Performance rank is decided

Quest compatible
Of course, if you have a story about performance Rank, you have to deal with Quest.What you can do with Quest should be the same as Quest avatars.Just like worlds and avatars, you need to upload a new one for Quest.

Inventory Display
Like World and Social, it will be called from the detailed menu. Therefore, a new UI tab will be added.
After calling, the detailed menu disappears. You can also remove it from the advanced menu.
If you reach the world limit, you must first remove the item from the inventory menu. Using the same UI for changing avatars, you can set up to 32 FAVs.

QUICK menu (mainly copy and block)
Just like the menu for the user, the center of the item is responsive and can invoke a special menu. You can also summon items or complete blocks for items, or summon them to yourself like an avatar clone.
(Personally, it might be nice to be able to put it directly into FAV instead of cloning to prevent confusion)

world
Limit the number of items that a player can call. Of course you need it, the default setting is 1 and the maximum is 5.
Because it is possible to call multiple grab items at once, not items that should be too diverse Set the number of summons as small as possible.

Safety
The safety performance Rank option is not linked to the avatar, but is determined individually for each item. (There can be a composition where a blocked robot wields an excellent item.)
ON / OFF for SAFETY USERRANK is applied to items as well as avatars. After being roughly associated with USERRANK and SAFETY settings and blocked by performance RANK An avatar block for an individual user also serves as an item block. 
Naturally, the user block erases everything.

Do you need anything else?
